formal modification <MATH_0013> we obtain a formal modification

By the main theorem on dilatations

<REF_0003>), there is a unique proper
morphism <MATH_0015> of algebraic spaces which is an isomorphism over
<MATH_0016> such that <MATH_0017> is isomorphic to the
displayed arrow. In other words, for some morphism
<MATH_0018> we have a cartesian diagram

The compatibility condition is that there should be a
morphism <MATH_0022> restricting to <MATH_0023> and <MATH_0024>
over <MATH_0025> and <MATH_0026>.
In other words, such that the diagram
<MATH_0027>

if it exists. We will indicate this situation by saying
